resources.string: How it works
Choose a PDF
Choose two or more PDFs
Choose an image
Choose one or more images
Choose a Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text or web file
Check the preview and options
Save or share the result. It is also kept in %1$s.
Combine two or more PDFs into one file, in the order you choose.
Break a PDF into smaller files: every page on its own, by page ranges or every few pages.
Put the pages in a new order and remove the ones you don\'t need.
Turn pages that were scanned sideways or upside down.
Pick the pages you need and save them as a new PDF.
Make a PDF smaller for email and messaging. Choose how much to shrink it.
Try to fix a PDF that won\'t open or shows errors, and save a clean copy.
Add page numbers to every page of a PDF.
Stamp text, such as “Confidential”, or an image across the pages.
Draw your signature and place it on any page.
Turn photos and images into one PDF, in the order you choose.
Turn Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text and web files into PDFs on your phone.
Read the text in scanned pages on your phone, so you can search, select and copy it.
Type into the fields of a PDF form and save the filled-in copy.
Save each page of a PDF as an image.
Copy the text out of a PDF into a Word or plain text file.
Turn the tables in a PDF into a spreadsheet you can edit.
Make a PowerPoint presentation from a PDF, one slide per page.
Lock a PDF with a password, so only people who know it can open it.
Remove the password or editing restrictions from a PDF you are allowed to open.
Trim an image down to just the part you need.
Make an image file smaller while keeping it clear.
Change images to PNG, JPG, WebP or PDF.
Change an image\'s width and height, or pick a preset such as passport size.
Scan in seconds
Tap %1$s at the bottom of the screen. ScanPro finds the edges, straightens each page and cleans it up.
Everything in one place
Your scans are saved on this phone, in %1$s. Sort them into folders and find any of them with Search.
PDF tools at hand
Merge, split, compress, sign and convert in %1$s. Everything runs on your phone, even offline.
